llm.summary: The skill's stated purpose (convert PDFs into course notes) is plausible, but the runtime instructions assume filesystem locations, tools, and environment variables that aren't declared and will modify existing files without safeguards — these mismatches deserve attention before installing.

dimensions.detail: The skill’s goal (generate Italian and English markdown notes and place them in a course folder) aligns with the instructions to read a PDF and write files. However the README assumes a specific local repo path (~/Documenti/github/polito/) and tool availability (pdftotext or Python) even though the package declares no required binaries or configuration — this is an inconsistency the user should be aware of.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to read the user's filesystem (list folders, infer lecture numbers), update or integrate into existing notes, and write files (potentially overwriting). It also mandates 'zero information loss' (copy all definitions/examples), which could surface sensitive content from PDFs. There are no explicit safeguards (backups, confirmation prompts, redaction rules) before modifying files or publishing content to an index.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec or code (instruction-only), which limits risk. However the instructions assume external tools (pdftotext or Python scripts) and a virtualenv ($VENV) without declaring or installing them — this is a minor coherence gap but not an installer risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials, but the instructions reference $VENV and a workspace path (~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/lookupmark-local-rag/...) and expect access to the user's home repository. Referencing undeclared env vars and internal workspace paths is an inconsistency and could be surprising to users.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request persistent inclusion (always:false) and has no install footprint. It does perform file writes/updates within the user's repo, which is expected for its purpose; there is no evidence it modifies other skills or system-wide configurations.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing or invoking this skill: 1) Understand it will read and write files in your home repository (~/Documenti/github/polito/) and may update/overwrite existing notes — make backups or test in a copy first. 2) The instructions assume tools (pdftotext or Python) and a virtual environment ($VENV) that are not declared; ensure those exist and review any scripts the agent runs. 3) The 'zero information loss' rule means all content from the PDF will be reproduced (potentially including sensitive data); do not run it on documents containing private or confidential information unless you are comfortable with that. 4) The skill references automatic indexing by a local RAG skill — if you use that, new notes may be searchable immediately; verify your indexing settings. 5) Prefer running the workflow manually for the first few uses and validate generated files before allowing any automated indexing or sharing.
